en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal city and harbor. Dense low-rise buildings spread up a hillside, with several chimneys and masts visible, and a bay with ships anchored to the right. At the top left is the printed caption in French, "Vue de Syra." There is a faint circular postal-style mark with Greek letters in the upper right and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the bottom.
